ana: Heads-up — GCP reached out with an opportunity to add capacity in eu-west4 (new AZ 4b). We need marketplace SKU entitlement + quota bump for GPUs. Want to align on ask and timing :calendar:

mike: Nice. Do we have exact SKU IDs and the target QPS/GPUs per region? Need to size the quota request.

ana: Sorry, typo — ana. SKU list below (from partner):

ana: ```
SKUS: compute.googleapis.com/NVIDIA_T4: 300
SKUS: compute.googleapis.com/NVIDIA_A100: 40
Marketplaces: redwood-inference-enterprise-v2
Region: europe-west4 (new az 4b)
Desired go-live: 2024-07-15
```

lia: Got it. Two quick notes: 1) For marketplace entitlements we need a partner-facing change window (GCP said ~7 business days). 2) KMS/HSM integration for Private deployments needs a service account allowlist — confirm the contact.

jin: For quota request flow, I'll open the Google console support ticket + attach projected consumption. Suggest we ask for a ~20% buffer above baseline. I can draft the ticket, will ping you for sign-off.

ana: Thanks — can you also add a note about fallback routing? If A100 scarcity hits, we'd want T4 autoscale policy to kick in and fallback mapping in the routing table. Short snippet: `fallback: if A100 unavailable -> model: gpt-a100 -> fallthrough: gpt-t4-quantized`

mike: From infra side, we need the node pool config for Dedicated customers pinned to the new AZ. Lia — is there any legal/contract blocker for marketplace SKU changes?

lia: Legal's ok on the wording, but they want the marketplace listing to explicitly call out data residency in eu-west4 and KMS options. I'll coordinate the copy with product.

jin: Drafted support ticket (private link): https://console.cloud.google.com/support/requests/INC-123456789 — assigned to GCP capacity team. Body includes projected monthly GPU hours and expected peak RPS.

quota-bot: quota-bot: automated note — current quota for NVIDIA_A100 in europe-west4: 10 (region-wide), NVIDIA_T4: 120. Request recommended: A100 -> 60, T4 -> 360.

ana: Perfect, quota-bot numbers match our needs after buffer. Action list: 1) Jin: submit GCP ticket (in progress). 2) Lia: update marketplace copy + legal sign-off (ETA 48h). 3) Mike: prep Dedicated node-pool config + canary plan. 4) Ana: coordinate partner comms and announcement schedule.

mike: I'll create the canary playbook and post in eng-releases channel once ready. ETA EOD tomorrow.

lia: I'll loop in legal and attach final copy to this thread.

ana: Thanks all — if GCP comes back with a shorter lead time we can accelerate. :rocket:

ana: tagging @here for visibility — partners ops, please note possible marketplace push mid-July.
